title: RSR-003: research challenge and independence controls in the gate
objective: Enforce the frozen research contract's challenge/independence controls (10-13): source-count-is-not-independence, computed challenge requirement, distinct researcher-excluded reviewers, no duplicate identity, declared non-coverage. Add a required researcher field.
business_value: A frozen contract is only real once its independence controls bite; a council that lets the author ballot or one identity count twice is theatre.
out_of_scope: state-transition (16) and traceability (18) controls -- later WPs
the nine P0 subskills; registry activation (badf-research stays DESIGNED)
acceptance_criteria: the challenged example passes; the plain example still passes
researcher-as-reviewer, duplicate reviewer, single reviewer, missing/non-list non_coverage, bad verdict all refused
mutation kills; compose green both shapes

rollback.method: revert the squash commit via PR

note: Lands IN_PROGRESS by design. Carries its own G07 self-dossier. Second research-track WP; 10 of 18 controls now enforced (1,2,4,5,7,9,10,11,12,13).
